title: csdid/0.1
description: Records of Stata csdid (Rios-Avila, Sant'Anna and Callaway; csdid.ado 1.71, surveyed 2026-10-25), the Callaway-Sant'Anna estimator; see spec/profiles/csdid.md. Includes did/0.1, plus: meta.estimator.method "callaway_santanna"; specification.did.cohort (gvar) and a comparison of never_treated or not_yet_treated; specification.options method, agg and typebase; a default vcov of type influence_function or wild_bootstrap; and structures.did with cells (e(gtt), which csdid always stores). When agg() aggregates, e(b)/e(V) hold the aggregates and e(b_attgt)/e(V_attgt) the ATT(g,t): both go in parameters, with the ATT(g,t) vcov as a second, non-default vcov.

x-tools.csdid: e(control_group): "Never Treated" / "Not yet Treated" (notyet); csdid switches to not-yet-treated when there are no never-treated units

method.description: e(method), resolved: dripw with covariates and reg without, when method() is not given.

outcome_model.description: Same as method; writers may fill both.

agg.description: e(agg), resolved (attgt when agg() is not given).

typebase.description: e(typebase): default (varying base period), long or long2.

saverif.description: File the RIFs were saved to (saverif()); identifying, as a path.

ssc.description: None: V = IF'IF / n^2 (cluster sums of the IF when clustered, with no G/(G-1)). Record {convention: "csdid", formula: "none"}.

cluster.description: cluster(), or, in a panel without cluster(), the unit variable: the influence function is summed per unit.

x-tools.csdid: e(gtt): cohort, t0 (base period), t1 (period), error (_rc), N, N_cntr, N_trt
e(cband) (columns b se t ll ul) when e(citype) is uniform
